title: The Thorn of Ironhollow Revisited
author: A. M. Villalobos
blurb: Jude Winterbourne, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
